problem:
Calculate the product $Q{I}_{2}$ given that ${I}_{2}$ is the $2\times 2$ identity matrix and
$Q=[\begin{aligned}7 & -7 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}].$

feedback.problem:
Calculate the product $J{I}_{2}$ given that ${I}_{2}$ is the $2\times 2$ identity matrix and
$J=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ -2 & -3\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
Any matrix, when multiplied by an identity matrix, remains unchanged (assuming that the multiplication is well defined).

The matrix $J$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix and ${I}_{2}$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix too. 

Therefore, the multiplication is well defined and 

$$
J\cdot {I}_{2}=J=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ -2 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$
